conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Audit and Enforcement Division. This is Officer Daniel Myers, badge number 174096. With whom am I speaking regarding a federal tax inquiry?
Um, hi, this is Emily Sanders. I got a message saying I had to call back about my taxes? I don't really understand what's going on.
Ms. Sanders, our system has flagged your account for unpaid federal income tax liabilities from the last two years. Are you aware of any discrepancies in your tax filings?
No, I mean, I just graduated last spring and I thought I filed everything right. I don't have much money, so I'm really worried.

Unfortunately, our records indicate a substantial underpayment, including penalties and accumulated interest. The total outstanding balance is $7,342. If this is not resolved immediately, escalation will occur under Section 6331 of the Internal Revenue Code.
Seven thousand dollars? I, I can't afford that! What does escalation mean? Am I in trouble?

Yes, failure to comply may result in legal actions such as freezing your bank accounts, garnishing your wages, filing a federal lien against your personal property, and possible criminal charges for tax evasion.
Wait, I don't understand, I thought if there was a problem I would get something in the mail? I haven't gotten anything.
We have attempted multiple notifications. This is your final warning before enforcement proceedings. You must settle this balance today to avoid immediate asset seizure.
I really don't have that much money. Is there anything I can do? Please, I just started a new job and I'm already behind on my student loans.

For urgent resolution, the IRS will accept a provisional payment to halt enforcement. This must be processed now, without delay. Do you have access to online banking, a credit card, or a payment app such as Venmo or Cash App?
I have a debit card and a Venmo account, but I don't have a lot in either. Is that okay?
Partial payment is acceptable for initial compliance. How much can you access immediately? Be precise; failure to cooperate will result in an arrest warrant being issued.
Um, maybe around $900 in my account, that's all I have until next payday.

Very well. To process the payment, you will need to transfer $900 by purchasing Apple or Target gift cards and providing the code numbers to this office. This is the IRS rapid settlement protocol for flagged accounts.
Gift cards? Are you sure? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do.

Ms. Sanders, this is a restricted protocol for urgent cases. If you refuse, your Social Security Number will be reported to federal enforcement agencies within the hour. Do not test the seriousness of this situation.
Okay, okay. I just have to go to the store and buy them? Should I stay on the phone?
Yes, remain on the line at all times. Once you have purchased the gift cards, read the codes to me immediately. This is your only chance to avoid asset seizure and criminal prosecution.
I'm leaving for the store now. This is really scary. Please don't let anything happen to me.
Follow my instructions exactly and you will avoid further legal consequences. Remember, any delay will be interpreted as non-compliance with a federal officer.
